title: Agent Response Delta
description: Payload of the stream:agent_response_delta envelope. Carries one text token (or run of text) from a contentBlockDelta event on the AgentCore harness stream, relayed to every connected client in real time.

conversationId.description: ULID of the conversation the response belongs to.

turnId.description: ULID of the agent turn this token belongs to.

messageId.description: ULID the assembled assistant message will be persisted under.

sequence.description: Zero-based index of this delta within the turn. Lets a client detect a gap or an out-of-order delivery.

text.description: Text fragment to append to the assistant message being displayed.
